answer_1.quote: Neural Machine Translation (NMT) has achieved great improvements ... We propose a Neural Vocabulary Selection (NVS) model ...

answer_2.quote: We evaluate translation quality using SacreBLEU and COMET. Automatic evaluation metrics show only very small differences between models.

answer_4.quote: We conduct human evaluations with two annotators on the subsets of newstest2020 and IDTS test sentences ... Professional bilingual annotators rate outputs of four systems concurrently in absolute numbers with increments of 0.2 from 1 (worst) to 6 (best).
answer_4.guideline: Source-based direct assessment where annotators assign an absolute quality score (1‑6) to each system output.
